p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # The non-background cells form a rectangle outline. Mark the missing
    # perimeter cells with 2, preserving the existing outline color.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    if not pts:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in pts); r1 = max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in pts); c1 = max(c for r, c in pts)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            if (r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1)) and out[r][c] == bg:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
